# Alarm Clock: Wake-Up Missions

> Reliable alarms for heavy sleepers. Solve a task to switch the alarm off.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.alarmclock&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/privacy/
- Tools
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/es/index.md

## About

Alarm Clock is made for people who sleep through normal alarms. It rings on the minute, gets louder step by step, and asks you to finish a short task before it lets you turn it off.

## Features

### Alarms

- Set as many alarms as you like, once or on chosen weekdays
- Add a label to each alarm
- Skip only the next ring of a repeating alarm
- Alarms are set again after a reboot and after a time or time zone change
- The alarm uses the alarm volume, so it also rings when the phone is on silent

### Wake-up missions

Pick one mission per alarm. You cannot skip it.

If a mission fails three times, the app offers an easier math problem so you are never stuck. If you leave the mission, the alarm rings again after one minute.

- Math: three difficulty levels, and you choose how many problems
- Shake: shake the phone as many times as you set
- QR code or barcode: scan a code you stuck somewhere you have to walk to, such as the bathroom
- Steps: walk the number of steps you set

### Snooze

Snooze is always available on the ringing screen. Set the interval from 1 to 30 minutes and the maximum number of snoozes from 0 to 10, or unlimited. Once a mission has started, snoozing is no longer possible.

### Sound and alerts

- Bundled tones, system ringtones, or your own audio file
- If your file is moved or deleted, a bundled tone rings instead, never silence
- Volume ramps up over a time you choose
- Vibration on or off for each alarm
- Optional flashlight strobe, off by default, with a photosensitivity warning before you can turn it on

### Reliability

Phones often stop apps to save battery. A setup guide walks you through the exact alarm, notification, full-screen and battery settings. It includes guides for Xiaomi, Samsung, Huawei, OnePlus, Oppo, Vivo and Realme, and a self-test alarm that rings one minute later.

### Extras

- Widget that shows your next alarm with a countdown
- Light and dark theme that follow your system
- Works on phones and tablets
- Labels for screen readers and large touch targets
- English and German

### Privacy

The app has no internet permission, no account and no analytics. Your alarms stay on your phone. Camera access is used only to scan a QR code for the QR mission. Activity recognition is used only to count steps for the steps mission. Both are requested only when you need them.

All features are available in the app. It has no in-app purchases.

### Open source

Alarm Clock is open source under the GNU GPL v3 or later.

Questions or feedback: apps@schimpf.es

## Guides

- [Alarm Not Going Off on Android: Causes and Fixes](https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/alarm-not-going-off-android/index.md): Why an Android alarm stays silent or rings late, and a checklist of settings to fix it, from exact alarms to battery limits.
- [Math Alarm Problems: Easy, Medium and Hard Examples](https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/math-alarm-problems-examples/index.md): See what easy, medium and hard math alarm problems look like, how they are built, and how to pick a level that wakes you up.
- [Snooze Time Calculator: How Late Will You Wake Up?](https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/snooze-time-calculator/index.md): Work out how many minutes snoozing costs you and when the last alarm rings. Includes a calculator and a worked example.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do?

It rings on the exact minute, raises the volume over a time you set (0 to 120 seconds) and asks for a mission before you can switch it off: math, shake, QR code or barcode, or steps. Snooze is available until the mission starts.

### Where is my data stored?

Only on your phone, in a local database. The app has no internet permission, no account and no analytics, so nothing is sent anywhere.

### Does it cost anything?

On Google Play you pay once when you install it. It is free on F-Droid and GitHub. There are no ads and no in-app purchases, and all features are included.

### Which Android versions are supported?

Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer, on phones and tablets. On Android 12 and 12L you may need to allow exact alarms in the app's special access settings.

### Can I skip the mission if I cannot solve it?

No. After 3 failed attempts the app offers an easy math problem so you are never stuck. If you leave the mission, the alarm rings again after one minute.

### Which languages does the app use?

English and German. The app follows your system language.

# Storage Analyzer: Big Files

> Find large files, duplicates and old junk, then clear space safely.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.adfreestorageanalyzer&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/privacy/
- Tools
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/es/index.md

## About

See what fills your phone and free up space, fully offline.

Storage Analyzer does not ask for the internet permission, so Android does not let it go online at all. No ads, no analytics, no crash reports, no account, no cloud. Everything it finds stays on your phone. You can check this yourself: the app shows its network permissions, read live from Android, on its privacy screen.

## Features

### What it finds

- Large files, sorted by size, with filters for images, videos, audio, documents, APKs and archives.
- Exact duplicates: files over 1 MB with the same size are compared by SHA-256 checksum, so only true copies are shown. The newest copy is kept by default, and at least one copy is always kept.
- Old files not changed for more than 90 days, grouped into Downloads, Screenshots, WhatsApp media, APK installers and other files.
- Folder sizes as a map you can tap through, with a list view and breadcrumb to go back.
- Space used by each app (app, data and cache), with a shortcut to the app's system settings to clear its cache.

### Safe delete

Deleted files go to the app's Trash first. Undo right away, or restore them from Trash for 7 days. After that they are deleted for good. Files are moved, not copied, so it is fast even for big videos. Folders are never deleted.

### You stay in control

- Scans run only when you tap Scan, never in the background.
- Full mode uses All files access to check every folder on internal storage and SD card.
- Prefer not to grant that? Limited mode only looks at the photos, videos and music Android shares with apps.
- Usage access is only asked for on the Apps screen, and only app sizes are read.

### Also

Note: uninstalling the app also empties its Trash. Restore files you want to keep first.

- Home screen widget with used storage, space you can free and last scan time.
- Light and dark theme from your system setting.
- Phone and tablet layouts.
- Works with screen readers.

## Guides

- [How to Find Duplicate Files on Android](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/find-duplicate-files-on-android/index.md): How to find exact duplicate files on an Android phone, how checksums prove two files are the same, and which copy to keep when you delete.
- [How to Find Old Unused Files on Android](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/find-old-files-on-android/index.md): Find files you have not changed for more than 90 days: old downloads, screenshots, WhatsApp media and APK installers. See the rules and a worked example.
- [MB to GB Conversion Chart for Phone Storage](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/mb-to-gb-conversion-chart/index.md): Convert MB to GB and back with a chart and a calculator. Learn why a 128 GB phone shows less space, with worked examples for GB and GiB.

## Questions and answers

### Does the app go online or share my data?

No. The app does not request the internet permission, so Android does not let it connect at all. It has no ads, analytics, crash reports or account, and its privacy screen shows the network permissions read live from Android.

### What does the app find, and what does it not do?

It finds large files, exact duplicates (same SHA-256 checksum), files not changed for more than 90 days, folder sizes and the space each app uses. It scans only when you tap Scan, never in the background, and it does not match similar photos or clear the cache of other apps for you.

### Are deleted files gone right away?

No. Deleted files go to the app's Trash, where you can undo or restore them for 7 days before they are deleted for good. Folders are never deleted, and uninstalling the app empties its Trash.

### Do I have to give access to all files?

No. Full mode uses All files access to check every folder on internal storage and the SD card. Limited mode only looks at the photos, videos and music that Android shares with apps.

### Which Android versions does it run on?

Android 10 and newer. Phone and tablet layouts, a light and dark theme and a home screen widget are included.

### Do I have to pay for anything besides the app?

No. The app is a one-time purchase on Google Play, with no subscription, no in-app purchases and no ads. The app is available in English only.
